frases.dice: Training a seven point five billion parameter model with Adam needs one hundred twenty gigabytes of memory.
frases.muestra: Training a 7.5-billion-parameter model with Adam needs 120 GB of memory.
frases.es: Entrenar un modelo de 7.500 millones de parámetros con Adam necesita 120 GB de memoria.

frases.dice: Spread across sixty-four G P Us with Zero three: one point nine per G P U.
frases.muestra: Spread across 64 GPUs with ZeRO-3: 1.9 GB per GPU.
frases.es: Repartido en 64 GPUs con ZeRO-3: 1,9 GB por GPU.

frases.dice: Tech capsule: distributed training, and three D parallelism.
frases.muestra: Tech capsule: distributed training and 3D parallelism.
frases.es: Cápsula técnica: entrenamiento distribuido y paralelismo 3D.

frases.dice: So where do sixteen bytes per parameter come from? Two for sixteen-bit weights, two for gradients, and twelve for the optimizer.
frases.muestra: Where do 16 bytes per parameter come from? 2 for 16-bit weights, 2 for gradients and 12 for the optimizer.
frases.es: ¿De dónde salen 16 bytes por parámetro? 2 de pesos en 16 bits, 2 de gradientes y 12 del optimizador.

frases.dice: Adam keeps a thirty-two bit copy, plus momentum and variance: three times four bytes.
frases.muestra: Adam keeps a 32-bit copy, plus momentum and variance: 3 × 4 bytes.
frases.es: Adam guarda una copia en 32 bits, más el momento y la varianza: 3 × 4 bytes.

frases.dice: Data parallelism puts a full copy of the model on every G P U, and splits the batch.
frases.muestra: Data parallelism copies the model to every GPU and splits the batch.
frases.es: El paralelismo de datos copia el modelo en cada GPU y reparte el lote.

frases.dice: Then they average gradients with a ring all reduce: each G P U sends about twice the model, no matter how many there are.
frases.muestra: Then they average gradients with a ring all-reduce: each GPU sends about twice the model, no matter how many there are.
frases.es: Luego promedian gradientes con un all-reduce en anillo: cada GPU envía casi el doble del modelo, sin importar cuántas sean.

frases.dice: The problem: every G P U repeats all sixteen bytes per parameter. Zero removes that redundancy.
frases.muestra: The problem: every GPU repeats all 16 bytes per parameter. ZeRO removes that redundancy.
frases.es: El problema: cada GPU repite los 16 bytes por parámetro. ZeRO elimina esa redundancia.

frases.dice: In three stages it shards the optimizer, the gradients and the weights: from one twenty, to thirty-one, to sixteen, to under two gigabytes. F S D P in PyTorch does the same.
frases.muestra: In three stages it shards the optimizer, the gradients and the weights: from 120 to 31, to 16, to under 2 GB. FSDP in PyTorch does the same.
frases.es: En tres etapas reparte el optimizador, los gradientes y los pesos: de 120 a 31, a 16, a menos de 2 GB. FSDP, en PyTorch, hace lo mismo.

frases.dice: And if a single layer does not fit, tensor parallelism splits its matrices across G P Us.
frases.muestra: If a single layer does not fit, tensor parallelism splits its matrices across GPUs.
frases.es: Si una sola capa no cabe, el paralelismo de tensores parte sus matrices entre GPUs.

frases.dice: Megatron cuts the first matrix by columns and the second by rows: a single all reduce per block. But it needs very fast links, inside one server.
frases.muestra: Megatron cuts the first matrix by columns and the second by rows: a single all-reduce per block. But it needs very fast links, inside one server.
frases.es: Megatron corta la primera matriz por columnas y la segunda por filas: un solo all-reduce por bloque. Pero exige conexiones rapidísimas, dentro del mismo servidor.

frases.dice: Pipeline parallelism splits the layers into stages, like an assembly line.
frases.muestra: Pipeline parallelism splits the layers into stages, like an assembly line.
frases.es: El paralelismo de pipeline reparte las capas en etapas, como una línea de montaje.

frases.dice: The cost is the bubble: idle time equals p minus one, over m plus p minus one. With four stages and four micro batches, forty-three percent. With thirty-two micro batches, nine percent.
frases.muestra: The cost is the bubble: idle time = (p − 1)/(m + p − 1). With 4 stages and 4 micro-batches, 43%. With 32, 9%.
frases.es: El costo es la burbuja: tiempo ocioso = (p − 1)/(m + p − 1). Con 4 etapas y 4 microlotes, 43 %. Con 32, 9 %.

frases.dice: Three D parallelism combines all three: tensors inside a server, pipeline across servers, and data on top.
frases.muestra: 3D parallelism combines all three: tensors inside a server, pipeline across servers and data on top.
frases.es: El paralelismo 3D combina los tres: tensores dentro del servidor, pipeline entre servidores y datos encima.

frases.dice: That is how a one trillion parameter model trained on three thousand seventy-two G P Us, at fifty-two percent of theoretical peak.
frases.muestra: That is how a 1-trillion-parameter model trained on 3,072 GPUs, at 52% of theoretical peak.
frases.es: Así se entrenó un modelo de un billón de parámetros en 3.072 GPUs, al 52 % del pico teórico.

frases.dice: Another trick: gradient checkpointing. You do not store every activation: you recompute them in the backward pass.
frases.muestra: Another trick: gradient checkpointing. You do not store every activation: you recompute them in the backward pass.
frases.es: Otro truco: gradient checkpointing. No guardas todas las activaciones: las recalculas en el backward.

frases.dice: With n layers, memory drops to the square root of n, for one extra forward pass: about a third more compute.
frases.muestra: With n layers, memory drops to √n, for one extra forward pass: ≈ a third more compute.
frases.es: Con n capas, la memoria baja a √n, a cambio de un forward extra: ≈ un tercio más de cómputo.

frases.dice: On Google Cloud, T P U v five p chips connect in a three D torus of up to eight thousand nine hundred sixty chips; with Jax, the same code is sharded through annotations. For G P Us, G K E orchestrates multi-node training.
frases.muestra: On Google Cloud, TPU v5p chips connect in a 3D torus of up to 8,960 chips; with JAX, the same code is sharded through annotations. For GPUs, GKE orchestrates multi-node training.
frases.es: En Google Cloud, los TPU v5p se conectan en un toro 3D de hasta 8.960 chips; con JAX, el mismo código se reparte con anotaciones de sharding. Para GPUs, GKE orquesta el entrenamiento en varios nodos.

frases.dice: The basics: sixteen bytes per parameter, all reduce equals reduce scatter plus all gather, the pipeline bubble, and that communication is compute too.
frases.muestra: The basics: 16 bytes per parameter, all-reduce = reduce-scatter + all-gather, the pipeline bubble, and that communication is compute too.
frases.es: Las bases: 16 bytes por parámetro, all-reduce = reduce-scatter + all-gather, la burbuja del pipeline, y que la comunicación también es cómputo.

frases.dice: If this helped, share and follow.
frases.muestra: If this helped, share and follow.
frases.es: Si te sirvió, compártelo y sígueme.
